detail: `format` is the 3.0 spelling of a fact 2020-12 moved to another member; 2020-12 defines no such format, so it was rewritten as that member
`type` is the discriminator of more than one union over this variant; the variant carries the property in neither, because each union writes it itself

the property may be absent and may be null, and the document says those are different; both become `None`. The type is reached from a request body, so a caller cannot send an explicit null, which is how a request says `clear this` rather than `leave it alone`

the property may be absent and may be null, and the document says those are different; both become `None`. The type is reached from no operation's body, so nothing on the wire is affected, because no operation carries it

the property may be absent, and its type also holds `null`; an explicit `null` is written out but read back as `None`, the same as absent. The type is reached from no operation's body, so nothing on the wire is affected, because no operation carries it

The type is reached from a request body and a response body, so neither a request nor a response read through the generated type can tell an explicit null from an absent member

this union declares no discriminator and one of its branches reads values its schema does not admit, such as an unlisted value of an enum, so it accepts payloads meant for a later branch that admits every value of its kind, so nothing decides which branch a payload is; the value is typed as arbitrary JSON rather than matched against whichever branch happens to parse first

this union declares no discriminator and one of its branches is an object that accepts the payloads of a later one, which is tried after it and so never reached, so nothing decides which branch a payload is; the value is typed as arbitrary JSON rather than matched against whichever branch happens to parse first

this union declares no discriminator and one of its branches lists the values it admits, but the type generated for it reads any value of its kind, so it accepts the payloads of a later one, which is tried after it and so never reached, so nothing decides which branch a payload is; the value is typed as arbitrary JSON rather than matched against whichever branch happens to parse first

this union declares no discriminator and one of its branches says nothing about the shape of its own payload and is not the last, so it accepts the payloads meant for every branch after it, so nothing decides which branch a payload is; the value is typed as arbitrary JSON rather than matched against whichever branch happens to parse first
